status: approved by the user on 23 October 2026
description: Retrieval benchmark for the Nigeria Police Act 2020 (as enacted, historical edition). Each query names the one provision that best answers it; Recall@10 is measured against the Police Act release's own retrieval documents. Queries mix everyday wording with legal wording and were checked against the approved text on 23 October 2026.

queries.query: What are the main duties of the Nigeria Police?
Who is on the Nigeria Police Council?
How is the Inspector-General of Police appointed and for how long?
What oath do police officers take when appointed?
queries.note: s.17 official, police and allegiance oaths.

queries.query: Who is responsible for recruiting police constables?
queries.note: s.18 IGP and Police Recruitment Committee.

queries.query: How is the Nigeria Police funded?
Must a police officer tell me why I am being arrested?
Can the police arrest a family member in place of a suspect?
Are the police allowed to torture a suspect?
What must be written down when the police arrest someone?
Where can the police stop and search people?
queries.note: s.49 power to stop and search.

queries.query: When can the police carry out an intimate body search?
queries.note: s.53 intimate search by ASP or above.

queries.query: Can I have a lawyer present when giving a statement to the police?
Can the police release me on bail after an arrest without warrant?
What can I do if the police detain me for over 24 hours without bail?
queries.note: s.64 remedy of suspect detained in custody.

queries.query: Can police officers prosecute cases in court?
Are my fingerprints destroyed if I am acquitted?
queries.note: s.68(2) records destroyed on discharge or acquittal.

queries.query: Do magistrates visit police stations to check detainees?
queries.note: s.70 monthly visits by chief magistrate.

queries.query: What should I do with lost property I find?
queries.note: s.88 take to police station within 24 hours.

queries.query: How do I report a missing person to the police?

queries.note: s.95 no private business except farming.

queries.query: What is the punishment for assaulting a police officer?

queries.note: s.100 alcohol and psychotropic substances on duty.

queries.query: Is it an offence to pretend to be a police officer?

queries.note: s.113 establishment of Community Policing Committee.

queries.query: What powers do traffic wardens have?

queries.note: s.131 Police Complaints Response Unit (printed Part XV, arrangement Part XVI).

queries.query: Can the police discriminate against women?

queries.note: s.139 repeal of Police Act Cap P19.
